verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU,sikyali ku bwange,
Nze ndi muddu wo buddu;
Nali mu nsi ya Ssetaani
N'ojja n'oginziyamu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Obulamu bwange bwonna
Mpaayo mu mikono gyo;
Ggwe-olinkuuma n'okutuusa
Olintuusa ewuwo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Era mpaayo-ensimbi zange
N'ebintu byange byonna;
N'ekitiibwa n'emikwano,
Leero byonna mbiwa ggwe.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Omubiri gwange gwonna,
Ebigere n'engalo;
N'amagezi gange gonna,
Byonna byonna bye bibyo.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.

verse.name: v9
verse.lines:
Nsanyuse,Yesu andeeta
Mu ggye ly'abatukuvu;
Be baweereza Katonda,
Be batuuka mu ggulu.

verse.name: v10
verse.lines:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.
